terms_summary.platform_role: MedBay operates an e-commerce marketplace in Egypt and is not a party to any contract for the sale or purchase of products advertised on the marketplace.
terms_summary.user_requirements: Users must be 18+, provide accurate registration information; accounts are personal and non-transferable.

terms_summary.returns_refunds: Managed by MedBay in accordance with the Returns Policy page.
terms_summary.content_rules: User content must be accurate, legal and appropriate; offensive material, spam, fake reviews, and off-platform transaction circumvention are prohibited.
terms_summary.liability: MedBay excludes liability for business losses, data corruption, and service interruptions; aggregate liability capped at amounts paid by the user.
terms_summary.governing_law: Laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt; Cairo courts have exclusive jurisdiction.

faqs.note: The live FAQ page lists 7 questions, but 6 of the 7 answers are duplicated WooCommerce placeholder text on the source site itself (not a fetch error) — only genuine content is imported below; the rest is intentionally left out rather than invented.

verified_qas.q: How do I change my account's default billing and shipping addresses?
verified_qas.a: Access "Address Book" or "Manage Addresses," then use "Add New Address" to create additional entries. During checkout, select your shipping address, then uncheck "My billing and shipping address are the same" on the payment page to choose different billing options from your saved addresses.
